title: TE attention backend silently ignored cu_doc_lens — intra-doc masking not applied
root_cause: TEAttentionBackend.forward accepted cu_doc_lens / max_doc_len arguments but did not pass them to TransformerEngine's attn kernel. Documents packed into a single sequence cross-attended each other instead of being masked at boundaries — full attention across all packed docs.
invariant: When cu_doc_lens is supplied, attention from token i must be limited to its own document; the TE backend must either honor cu_doc_lens or refuse the call.
diff_summary: TEAttentionBackend.forward now raises RuntimeError when any intra-doc-mask argument is set (so the silent path is no longer reachable).
silent_check: Buggy version did not raise — TE attention ran on the packed sequence without intra-doc masking, returning finite outputs; gradients flowed and training proceeded with cross-document leakage as a silent SDC.
